voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.32 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: Tatlong katok, sa hatinggabi. At may mamamatay sa bahay na iyon.
lines.beat_before: hook: across the street, three robed figures at a door; three knocks; that window lights

lines.text: Sa mga lumang kuwento, tatlo silang naglalakad sa gabi. Nakabalabal. Hindi mo makikita ang mukha.
lines.beat_before: the crane rises over the barangay: the three walk under the one streetlight

lines.text: Kakatok sila nang tatlong beses. Buksan mo man o hindi, may mamamatay pa rin. Ang pinakamatanda. O ang may sakit.
lines.beat_before: a door: knock, knock, knock; a window lights; later a candle in that window

lines.text: Kaya noon, gumuguhit ang mga tao ng puting krus sa pinto.
lines.beat_before: through our jalousie: Nanay chalks a white cross on our door, fast

lines.text: Ngayong gabi, sa kabilang bahay. Tapos sa kasunod.
lines.beat_before: the crane: house after house, a light, then a candle; they come up our street, skipping the crossed doors
from our window: they stop at our gate; one turns its hood to the window
they move on; the dogs start again; Nanay breathes; we lower the jalousie

lines.text: Hanggang may kumatok. Mula sa loob. Sa kuwarto ni Lola.
lines.beat_before: inside: the hall; three knocks on Lola's door, from the inside; her door's light goes out
